Only the name is captured, and the small model rightly stops: insufficient evidence, further investigation. Yet the record claims a nationality agreement and cites, as its proof, the line Nationality: not captured. The decision is right and the evidence is not; the five separate scores below show both. Under the v2 checks this citation is refused and the answer goes back for a repair.

The repair call then split them: the large model corrected the comparison, while the small model kept it and bent its disposition to match, insufficient evidence. The router escalated on an observable reason, an agreement and a conflict side by side, so the large model's repaired answer is the one kept. With the small model alone this case ended as a needless stop in all three runs.
